newsitem.title: LATVIA: UNIBANKA SAYS EUROBOND WILL BE ISSUED IN SUMMER.
newsitem.headline: UNIBANKA SAYS EUROBOND WILL BE ISSUED IN SUMMER.

text.p: Latvia's Unibanka on Tuesday confirmed that Credit Swisse First Boston (CSFB) will lead its upcoming eurobond and that the issue will be completed in two months' time.
The bank declined to say in a statment what sum the bond would be.
The bank's shareholders' meeting on Monday approved the eurobond issue to attract new, cheaper long-term financial resources, the statement said.
"The decision will allow Unibanka's management to complete its talks with one of the leading investment banks, CSFB," the bank said.
The bank said that its BBB credit rating from Standard and Poor's and its successful financial perfomance have created favourable conditions for tapping the international capital markets.
